name: Jōhana (Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Jōhana town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a pointed top and bottom enclosing the character 城.
history: Flag of the former town of Jōhana in Toyama Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01.

features.role: Jōhana town emblem — an outlined ring with a pointed top and bottom enclosing the character 城
